pain_point: No warehouse stock available in right size
primary_text: "There's literally nothing available to buy in the size range we need in the west." We know. That's exactly why we're building these. Brand-new off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina, designed specifically for small businesses who need units between 150–500sqm. No more scrolling through listings that are too big, too old, or already snapped up. Located 20km west of Melbourne CBD with direct access to Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel. These are purpose-built for owner-occupiers, not speculators. Stock this size won't last — register now.
description: Purpose-built 150–500sqm warehouses in Truganina — the size small businesses actually need.
